newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto to visit Malaysia on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto to visit Malaysia on Sunday.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto is to fly to Malaysia on Sunday for talks with Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, State Secretary Murdiono said on Thursday.
"There is no special agenda for this visit. Both leaders will have an exchange of ideas and information," he said.
Suharto was scheduled to hold talks with Mahathir on Monday and to return home the same day, he said.
Murdiono said he and Foreign Minister Ali Alatas would accompany Suharto during the visit.

Armed Forces chief General Feisal Tanjung was quoted by the Antara news agency as saying on September 22 that Suharto and Mahathir would discuss the Sipadan and Ligitan islands, off the coast of Borneo, which both countries claim.
Alatas said last month that Indonesia hoped the dispute over the Sipadan and Ligitan islands could be settled amicably.
He has said that Indonesia would agree to International Court arbitration in the Hague if necessary, but that the two countries would first seek a bilateral solution.
